name: Social Share
description: Adds share buttons for X, LinkedIn, Facebook, WhatsApp, e-mail and copy link under your articles. Plain links and inline icons: no third-party scripts, no tracking.

panels.title: Share buttons
panels.description: The row of share buttons under your articles. Every button is a plain link; nothing loads from another site.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Show share buttons
fields.description: Show share buttons. Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: heading
fields.title: Heading
fields.description: The line above the buttons. Leave it empty for no heading.

choices.title: Minimal icons in the accent colour

fields.name: accent
fields.title: Accent colour
fields.description: Used by the copy-link button, the minimal style and the keyboard focus ring.

fields.name: x
fields.title: X
fields.description: A button to post the article on X.

fields.name: linkedin
fields.title: LinkedIn
fields.description: A button to share it on LinkedIn.

fields.name: facebook
fields.title: Facebook
fields.description: A button to share it on Facebook.

fields.name: whatsapp
fields.title: WhatsApp
fields.description: A button to send it in WhatsApp.

fields.name: email
fields.title: E-mail
fields.description: A button that opens a new e-mail with the title and link.

fields.name: copy
fields.title: Copy link
fields.description: A copy-link button. It needs JavaScript in the reader's browser and stays hidden without it.

fields.name: only
fields.title: Only on pages starting with
fields.description: Slugs or prefixes, separated by commas, e.g. "blog, news". Empty means every page.

fields.name: exclude
fields.title: Never on
fields.description: Slugs separated by commas. A trailing * matches a prefix. "home" by default.

fields.name: site-address
fields.title: Site address
fields.description: e.g. https://example.com. Optional: learned on publish when the site has a domain, and read from the browser otherwise.
